supporting_observations.claim: At 13:41:21 UTC, RIVERBEND\dev.sharma registered \RB-IT\Deploy-VetChart on WS-HITO-01. Its configured action was msiexec.exe /i \\FILE-RB-01\Deploy\VetChart-4.2.msi /qn.

The registration used logon ID 0xe77bd25, matching dev.sharma's preceding network logon from WS-DSHARMA-01 at 13:36:36 UTC. This supports attribution to an administrative session from the designated IT workstation.

The registering account, task naming convention, installer command, deployment share, application version, target host, and afternoon timing match the supplied IT deployment practice and scheduled VetChart change. This supports a benign disposition for the alerted registration.
The task XML specifies an enabled time trigger, Hidden=false, and RunLevel=LeastPrivilege; its sole configured action is the VetChart installer command.

known_telemetry_limitations: S24-00109 establishes task registration and configuration, not execution or installation success. The supplied evidence does not include a corresponding msiexec process record or installer completion result.
The installer path in S24-00109 does not establish the MSI's contents, hash, signature, or integrity.
claims_not_established: Whether the configured VetChart installation executed successfully (S24-00109 records registration only).
Whether dev.sharma's credentials were used by their legitimate owner; the matching session establishes account and reported source workstation, not human identity (S24-00085, S24-00109).
Whether the MSI was independently verified against an approved package (S24-00109 supplies only its path).
unrelated_findings: Separate validation ticket: PROXY-RB-01 initiated a TCP connection to WS-HITO-01 port 135 at 13:52:41 UTC. These records establish the connection but not its administrative purpose or any relationship to the earlier task registration; it does not decide this alert (S24-00142, S24-00143, S24-00144).

Separate software-inventory review: explorer.exe loaded C:\Program Files\7-Zip\7-zip.dll with Signed=false and SignatureStatus=Unavailable. 7-Zip is not listed in the supplied approved-software inventory; the record alone does not establish maliciousness or a connection to the deployment task (S24-00110).
